LanguageData.IAG_Setting_ForesightDesc: When disabled, the divine foresight miracle cannot be used and threats are never delayed by prophecies.
LanguageData.IAG_NoTier: You have no followers. A god without believers has no power.
LanguageData.IAG_FaithTip: Faith is offered by your followers: a little every day from their devotion, more when they pray at a divine shrine, and much more when they hold rituals of your ideoligion.\n\nThe maximum grows with your tier and your number of followers.
LanguageData.IAG_FollowersTip: Colonists who believe in your colony's primary ideoligion. Slaves count as half a follower.
LanguageData.IAG_PassiveFaithTip: Faith offered every day without prayer, proportional to the certainty of your followers. Prayer and rituals add more.
LanguageData.IAG_StrainTip: Every miracle adds 1 strain, which fades by 0.5 per day. Each point of strain makes miracles 15% more expensive.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphetTip: Great miracles are channeled through your prophet: the moral guide of your ideoligion, or its leader if there is no moral guide. Channeling strains the prophet, who cannot channel again while overwhelmed.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoIdeo: Your colony has no ideoligion to be the god of. This mod requires the Ideology DLC.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoProphet: You have no prophet to channel this miracle. Assign a moral guide or leader in your ideoligion.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetIncapable: {PROPHET_labelShort} is in no state to channel a miracle.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetNotHere: {PROPHET_labelShort} must be on this map to channel the miracle.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetOverwhelmed: {PROPHET_labelShort} is overwhelmed by divine power and must rest first.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_Fogged: You cannot work miracles where your people cannot see.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetColonyPawn: Must target a member of the colony or a prisoner.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetFollower: Must target one of your followers.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoCrops: There are no growing crops there.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoEnemies: There are no enemies there to terrify.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetCorpse: Must target the body of a dead person.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NotABeliever: {PAWN_labelShort} did not believe in you in life.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_Dessicated: The body is too far gone.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ForesightDisabled: Divine foresight is disabled in the mod settings.
LanguageData.IAG_ForesightText: Your eyes open upon the threads of fate. For the next {0}, every threat sent against your colony will be revealed to you {1} before it arrives.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphecyText: A vision comes to you: {0} will befall {1} in about {2}.\n\nPrepare your people.
LanguageData.IAG_MendDone: The wounds of {PAWN_labelShort} close under a divine touch.
LanguageData.IAG_TerrorReason: Saw the true face of a god.
LanguageData.IAG_ResurrectDone: {PAWN_labelShort} has been called back from beyond!
LanguageData.IAG_IncarnationText: You descend into the flesh of {PAWN_labelShort}. For one day, your faithful will see their god walk among them.
LanguageData.IAG_ConvertedByMiracle: Having witnessed a miracle, {PAWN_labelShort} has converted to {1}.
